question: On the vLLM fork's G2 dumps, does any core group's top-64 KL to the 6-bit core grow with position along the fixed science-question traces?
statement: Exploratory (criteria written before computing): the per-trace slope of top-64 KL on log2(position) is below 0 for every swap arm except lm_head, e.g. whole core −0.019 [−0.055, −0.0008], mla_q_b −0.020 [−0.054, −0.0006], mla_o −0.011 [−0.030, −0.0007]. The second 6-bit launch gives +0.0004 [−0.0000, +0.0007] and lm_head +0.0003 [−0.0001, +0.0007].
quantity: mean over traces of the OLS slope of per-row top-64 KL(k6, arm) on log2(position), nats/token per doubling
sign: above 0 = the arm's divergence from the 6-bit core grows along the trace
n: 93 traces, 11 questions; one launch per arm
interval: 95% bootstrap clustered by question (11 questions), 2,000 replicates, numpy default_rng(20261105) (analysis/position.py)
